summary: Well-structured three-tier test suite with good coverage of core functionality. Unit tests exercise pattern matching, label assignment, priority ordering, and config loading. Integration tests via act validate end-to-end workflow execution. Workflow structure tests ensure YAML validity and actionlint compliance. Strengths: clear fixture management, exact output assertions, good error handling for file/JSON issues, proper cleanup. Gaps: limited edge cases (no tests for empty rule arrays, null values, special regex chars in paths, case sensitivity, path separators); only 3 act integration cases (by design); minimal boundary condition testing; TDD process not explicitly demonstrated. Would catch most common regressions but some edge cases could slip through.
